rationale: Counter-screen with the same Brunello library and ACE2-HEK293T cells infected with VSV-G-pseudotyped mNeonGreen retrovirus: reporter-low vs high, no-replicate path. Genes enriched here (e.g. LDLR, the VSV-G receptor) act on retroviral entry/reporter steps shared with the spike screen, and subtracting them isolates spike-specific entry factors.
